full_prompt_en: A square modernist oil painting shows an empty pale concrete pier stretching toward a flat distant horizon beside dark water, under a startlingly divided red and teal sky. The pier begins broad at the lower edge and narrows sharply toward the center, its long diagonal boundaries creating the strongest structure in the image. Its surface is creamy white with broad muted gray and ocher scuffs, interrupted by a few horizontal joint lines and blue-gray shadow patches. To the left of the pier, a wet dark strip reflects parts of a small group of buildings. The nearest structure is a low cream-colored shed with a dark open doorway and rust-red base, positioned just left of center. A darker block extends from it toward the left edge. A tall slim lamp post rises beside the buildings, its light head a tiny dark mark near the upper-left corner. On the right, the pier has a bright low parapet beyond which broad deep blue-green water spreads to the horizon. A narrow yellow ocher band lies at the far edge, keeping the otherwise spare distance legible. The upper background divides vertically into a large burnt red field on the left and a dark desaturated teal field on the right; the irregular boundary between them is softened by faint scraped marks. The planes are almost flat, but worn pigment, seams, and brush drag give them a matte material presence. Light feels even and low, catching the pale pier and building faces while dark wet ground and water hold cool shadow. No figures or readable writing appear. The overall composition is austere and still, using the pier's strong taper to pull the eye through a small cluster of buildings into broad chromatic emptiness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形现代主义油画描绘一条空旷浅色混凝土码头，沿深色水面伸向平直遥远的地平线，上方是令人惊讶地分成红色与青绿色的天空。码头在下边缘十分宽阔，向中央急剧收窄，长长的斜边构成画面最强的结构。表面呈奶油白色，带宽阔的低调灰与赭色磨痕，间有几条水平接缝和蓝灰阴影块。码头左侧，一道湿润深色区域映出小建筑群的一部分。最近的建筑是一座低矮奶油色棚屋，有深色敞开的门和铁锈红基座，位于中央偏左。更暗的建筑块从它伸向左边。高而细的灯柱立在房屋旁，灯头是左上角附近的小深色笔迹。右边，码头有一条明亮低栏，栏外宽阔深蓝绿水面铺到地平线。远边缘一道狭窄黄赭色带让极简的远景仍可读。上方背景竖向分为左侧大片焦红和右侧低饱和深青绿；两者不规则的界线被淡淡刮擦笔迹柔化。色面几乎平坦，但磨旧颜料、接缝和拖刷痕赋予它们哑光材料感。光线均匀而低暗，点亮浅色码头与房屋表面，深湿地面和水面留在冷影里。画中没有人物或可读文字。整体构图克制静止，以码头强烈收尖的透视线带视线穿过小建筑群，进入宽阔的色彩空旷处。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a spare modernist oil finish made from large matte color fields and long, sharply converging planes. Burnt red, dark teal, cream, blue-black, and a thin ocher accent are separated into bold areas with little tonal gradation. Geometry carries the spatial drama: broad foreground trapezoids taper to a narrow center while a high vertical color break divides the upper field. Edges are mostly firm but slightly irregular from dragged, rubbed pigment. Fine scuffs and joint-like lines keep the otherwise flat surfaces tactile. Even low light favors pale planes, leaving adjacent dark areas quiet and dense rather than dramatically modeled. Small upright marks punctuate the broad horizontal emptiness. The overall effect is austere, architectural in rhythm, and chromatically vivid.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有简约现代主义油画完成面，由大片哑光色域与长长急剧汇聚的平面组成。焦红、深青绿、奶油色、蓝黑和一条薄赭色强调分成大胆区域，色调渐变很少。几何形承担空间戏剧性：宽阔前景梯形向狭窄中心收拢，上方一道高竖向色彩分界切开色域。边缘大体坚定，却因拖拽和擦磨的颜料略不规则。细小磨痕与接缝般的线条让原本平坦的表面有触感。均匀低位光偏向浅色平面，相邻深色区域安静而浓重，没有夸张塑形。小小竖向笔迹点在宽阔水平空旷处。整体效果克制，节奏如建筑结构，色彩鲜明。
theme_en: An empty pale pier leading past a small building toward a flat sea
theme_zh: 空旷浅色码头经过小屋通向平静海面
name: Raimonds Staprans
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
